title: Fremantle Panther
style: Phonk comedy with dembow-leaning bounce, swung handclaps, clipped beatbox kicks, and a sneaky sub line; verses swap between Corey, Michelle, Ruby, and Wesley, then pre-chorus tightens to hand percussion and harmonica answers. Chorus lands with gang vocals, call-and-response Spanish licks, and playful ad-libs. Sun-bleached but dark, punchy and coastal, with conga pops, bottle taps, and a roomy mic sheen., comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[Corey]
Down by the jetty, I’m late again
Sand in my socks and a grin on my chin
[Michelle]
I brought the chips, he brought the kite
Wind from the west got us acting too bright
[Ruby]
Mira, look there, by the fish-and-chips stand
Big black cat with a swagger so grand
[Wesley]
He stole my sausage roll, then dipped in the shade
And the pelican laughed like it knew he got paid

[Pre-Chorus]
[Corey]
Shh, hear that step
On the boards by the sea
[Michelle]
Sneaky little shadow
With a salty-man tease
[Ruby]
Ay, gato, dónde vas?
[Wesley]
He just winked at me

[Chorus]
Black cat, black cat
On the jetty
Black cat, black cat
Too quick, too sneaky
Mira, mira, hey
He’s got the whole bay
Black cat, black cat
Run, but he stays

[Verse 2]
[Michelle]
Corey tried posing, all cool and tall
Cat took his sunnies, now he can’t see at all
[Corey]
I chased that rascal past the bait shop door
He slid like a sock on the wet, wet floor
[Ruby]
Oye, he jumped on the dinghy, click-clack-clack
Then he came back like, “Who, me?” in black
[Wesley]
I offered a snag and he judged my plate
Then he stole my last bite, mate, that’s fate

[Pre-Chorus]
[Michelle]
Wind in the sails
And a beat in the sand
[Wesley]
That cat got rhythm
And a master plan
[Ruby]
No lo veo
Then he’s gone again
[Corey]
West coast legend
With a grin on ten

[Chorus]
Black cat, black cat
On the jetty
Black cat, black cat
Too quick, too sneaky
Mira, mira, hey
He’s got the whole bay
Black cat, black cat
Run, but he stays

[Bridge]
[Michelle]
Tap-tap on the timber
Beatbox in the air
[Corey]
Harmonica crying
Like it knows he’s there
[Ruby]
Eh, señor sombra
Come back for the show
[Wesley]
We all start laughing
’Cause he already knows

[Final Chorus]
Black cat, black cat
On the jetty
Black cat, black cat
Too quick, too sneaky
Mira, mira, hey
He’s got the whole bay
Black cat, black cat
Run, but he stays
Black cat, black cat
We all say hello
Black cat, black cat
Then he’s gone—¡adiós!
